agentWorkspace.contextDescription: Give agents shared business context before they analyze your project. These instructions are guidance, not permission to access other projects or spend credits.
agentWorkspace.businessHint: What does your business do and what makes it different?
agentWorkspace.audienceHint: Who are your customers, and what do they need?
agentWorkspace.productsHint: Describe your key products, services and positioning.
agentWorkspace.goalsHint: What should an analysis help you achieve?
agentWorkspace.agentRulesHint: Preferred tone, constraints and instructions for agents. Do not include credentials.
agentWorkspace.validation: Use up to 4,000 characters per field.
agentWorkspace.readOnly: You can view context. Editing requires a writable project and a member role.
agentWorkspace.reportsDescription: Saved analyses from your project, including AI research and site audits. Share a report link with project members.
agentWorkspace.emptyDescription: Run an analysis or save a report to build your project history.
agentWorkspace.title: Title
agentWorkspace.membersOnly: Only project members can open this link.
agentWorkspace.historyLimit: Showing the latest 100 reports. Use the API cursor to read older history.
agentWorkspace.reportValidation: Enter a title (up to 160 characters) and analysis (up to 12,000 characters).
